title: Prospect Lattice: Prioritized Micro-Competitor Dossiers + Alert Recipes
creator: Lena Zhao
description: Goal: Build a repeatable lightweight dossier and alert recipe system (Prospect Lattice) that fuses public model telemetry, open-source release signals, and our customer usage telemetry to surface emergent competitor risk and procurement opportunities. The output is: (1) a one-page micro-dossier per model flavor (latency, cost, quantization readiness, tolerated context lengths, known failure modes, licensing caveats), (2) alert recipes that map signal thresholds to actionable playbooks (e.g., route traffic to fallback variant, open procurement RFx, spin up canary on Dedicated), and (3) a prioritized watchlist feed surfaced in the Console and PM Ops Slack channel.
acceptance_criteria: A reproducible template exists for micro-dossiers (JSON + human summary) and produces a new dossier from signals within 48h of a model release.
Three alert recipes implemented as runnable playbooks: (a) emergent-low-latency-variant (b) cost-arbitrage-trigger (c) license-change-blocker — each with clear owner and automated notification path.
Watchlist feed integrated into Console placeholder panel with sortable fields: model, region risk, estimated cost delta, and last-seen-signal.
Pilot: 4 prioritized models tracked for 6 weeks and at least one triggered alert that leads to an ops action (routing change, procurement task, or rollback).
Runbook and handoff to PM Ops and Solutions Engineering with triage steps and linked GitHub/Confluence artifacts.
Legal confirms licensing caveat extraction field and flags for enterprise-impacting changes.
tasks: Discovery: interview 6 enterprise customers and 4 sales leads about recent model-switch pain points and what signals would be meaningful.
Design dossier schema (fields: model-id, provider, flavor, quantized-variants, median-latency-by-seq, token-cost-est, eviction-risk-score, license-summary, sample-regression-signatures).
Prototype signal ingestion pipeline: public-release-watcher (GH/Releases), model-bench-scraper, internal-telemetry-join (usage/kps), and a lightweight scoring function.
Implement 3 alert recipes and map to Console notifications + PM Ops Slack integration.
Create Console watchlist panel mock and hand to Design for review.
Legal sync for license extraction heuristics and flag definitions.
Run 6-week pilot and collect outcomes and cost/latency delta metrics.
Documentation: Confluence PRD, runbook, and stakeholder playbook for procurement triggers.
